sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: discogs.com: pointing at a MusicBrainz icon shows that entity's MusicBrainz card, read from musicbrainz.org, and Space opens its window. This works in the MusicBrainz column of the script's tables and for the icons murdos' "Import Discogs releases to MusicBrainz" puts beside the names on Discogs' own page, right away. A click on an icon in the MusicBrainz column now opens the window, like every other link in those tables; Ctrl-click still opens MusicBrainz in a new tab.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: discogs.com: Discogs' own links in the page (artists, labels, releases, masters, users) now show their preview card on hover right away, before any of the script's buttons is pressed. Only the links in the script's own tables did before. The older Discogs pages (submissions, a release's history, a user's ratings) are covered too.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: discogs.com: a link to a Brucebase show, venue or person in Discogs' content (a release's notes, for example) shows Brucebase's own card, as on Brucebase, instead of a plain web page card.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Collection preview windows: the covers of a release or release group collection are now the table's first column, next to their rows, as in a release group's window, instead of a strip above the table.

Pointing at a cover in a collection window or a release group window (each release's, and the group's own) shows every image of that release or release group, and a click or Space opens them in the artwork viewer. Ctrl-click still opens its page.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Preview windows: Space on an image opens the full-screen viewer at that image, the same as a click, in Brucebase, Discogs and MusicBrainz windows alike. It used to do nothing. Esc closes the viewer and leaves the window open.

Discogs windows: the small pictures in a master's versions, an artist's discography and a label's releases now work like the Image column on Discogs pages. Pointing at one shows every image of that release (one request to Discogs, kept), and a click or Space opens the viewer on them, with Shift+← → to step through the rows. A click on the picture no longer opens that release in the window instead.
